all_team_tasks.description: Local development only. With ph_debug=true, list all project tasks for debugging. Ignored outside local development.

archived.description:
Filter by archived state. Defaults to excluding archived tasks. Use 'true' to list only archived tasks, 'false' for the default, or 'all' to include both.

* `true` - true
* `false` - false
* `all` - all

basic.description: With true, return basic list rows for summary surfaces: each row omits the full description and includes description_preview, its first 1000 characters. Defaults to false, which returns full task rows with description. The search parameter still matches description text server-side.

channel.description: Filter tasks to a channel's feed.

ci_status.description:
Filter tasks by the CI check rollup on their most recent run's pull request, as last observed from GitHub. 'none' means the PR has no checks.

* `passing` - passing
* `failing` - failing
* `pending` - pending
* `none` - none

client_provenance.description:

* `posthog_desktop` - PostHog Desktop
* `posthog_mobile` - PostHog Mobile
* `posthog_web` - PostHog Web

commented_by.description: Filter to tasks carrying a thread comment written by this user ID.

hog_flow_id.description: Filter tasks to the runs spawned by this workflow's 'Create AI task' action.

internal.description:
Filter by the internal flag, which controls whether a task is shown by default, not whether it is accessible. Defaults to excluding internal tasks. Use 'all' to include both internal and user-facing tasks, or 'true' to list only internal tasks. All values are available to any team member; access stays governed by task visibility.

* `true` - true
* `false` - false
* `all` - all

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

mentions.description: Filter to tasks whose thread mentions this user ID.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

ordering.description:
Sort order. '-last_activity_at' is newest activity first, where activity means a thread message or a run starting, streaming, or finishing. Defaults to '-created_at'.

* `-created_at` - -created_at
* `-last_activity_at` - -last_activity_at

pinned.description: With true, only tasks the requesting user has pinned.

pr_state.description:
Filter tasks by the state of their most recent run's pull request, as last observed from GitHub (webhooks plus the CI follow-up snapshot).

* `open` - open
* `draft` - draft
* `merged` - merged
* `closed` - closed

repository.description: Filter by repository name (can include org/repo format)

search.description: Case-insensitive substring search over task title and description. A numeric value also matches the task number. An empty value disables the filter.

sources.description: Only tasks from any of these sources. Repeat the parameter for each source, or send one comma-joined value or a JSON array. 'posthog_desktop', 'posthog_mobile' and 'posthog_web' match user-created tasks by the client that created them, and a user-created task from no other known client counts as desktop. 'posthog_web' also matches PostHog AI tasks. Any other value matches the task's origin product.
